name: smwgraphics-mega-man-the-wily-wars
title: Mega Man: The Wily Wars
description:
My first submission to the site, this is a graphic rip of the font used in Mega Man - The Wily Wars. It would work well in cutscenes, but it could work in other areas too. :)

The ExGFX file is supposed to be inserted in the FG3 slot.

This is a layer 2 FONT, so use it in conjunction with Layer 1 to make cutscenes.
